versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the monitoring-tech-acquisition-news-google skill.
- Monitors tech acquisition and M&A activity using apidojo's Google Search scraper.
- Returns acquisition announcements, involved companies, deal size indicators, and strategic rationale.
- Designed for M&A analysts, founders, investors, and competitive intelligence users.
- Supports custom search terms, classification of news results, and automatic scoring of result quality and relevance.
